name: Deco AI
description: Describe a vibe and Claude decorates your level or builds a rough layout, right in the editor

claude-title.name: Claude
claude-title.description: Deco AI asks Claude for a deco plan. You need your own Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com). Presets work without a key.

api-key.name: Anthropic API key
api-key.description: Starts with sk-ant-. Stored only on this PC and only sent to api.anthropic.com.

model.name: Claude model
model.description: claude-sonnet-5-5 is fast and cheap. claude-opus-5-5 plans better deco but costs more.

max-objects.name: Max objects per run
max-objects.description: Deco AI thins out background and particles to stay under this.

first-channel.name: First colour channel
first-channel.description: Deco AI uses 11 colour channels starting here (skips any your level already uses).

first-editor-layer.name: Editor layer for deco
first-editor-layer.description: Deco goes on this editor layer so you can hide it while editing gameplay. 0 = normal layer.
